test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which organisations have launched Blue Dot hubs to boost protection for children and families on the move across Europe?
solution:
The correct answer is __**UNICEF and UNHCR.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **UNICEF** and the **UNHCR **have launched **“Blue Dot hubs”** to boost protection for children and families on the move across Europe.
 
• The hubs will be located in selected strategic sites like border entry/exit points, registration sites, some strategic urban centres, etc.
 
• The services include:
 
 
• restoring family links
 
• family reunification
 
• child-friendly space
 
• dedicated mother and baby/toddler spaces
 
• psychosocial first aid
 
• legal counselling
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Twenty Child and Family Support Hubs, to be known as** “Blue Dots".**
 
• The hubs aim to support vulnerable families on the move, especially the many unaccompanied or separated children at risk of sickness.
 
• The **“Blue Dot” **hubs come at a time when women and children account for two-thirds of those crossing to Europe.
 
• The hubs will be located in selected strategic sites:
 
 
• border entry/exit points
 
• registration sites
 
• some strategic urban centres
 
• mobile/outreach teams
